notes:
v4.6.120 — Capital changes don't count as P/L + graphs skip closed hours

💰 Re-allocating a bot (or any deposit/withdrawal of its capital) no longer shows up as profit or loss. Each bot now records how much capital it holds, so when you change an allocation the P/L baseline resets to right after the change — only real trading gains/losses count.

📈 The lifetime and drawdown charts now skip overnight and weekend gaps (like the performance chart already did), so the line draws close-to-close instead of flat-lining when the market is shut.

Update via the in-app banner.
